India Wins Galle Test; Suthar Stars, Jadeja Reaches Wicket Milestone

India defeated Sri Lanka in the Galle Test match, with spinner Manav Suthar emerging as a key performer. Suthar's bowling, described as a "masterclass" and "dream ball," was instrumental in India's victory. All-rounder Ravindra Jadeja also achieved a significant milestone, becoming the fifth Indian to take 350 Test wickets. The match saw Suthar perform exceptionally well in only his second Test, while Jadeja's consistent performance was noted by former cricketers. The win was achieved despite challenging conditions, including rain.
